senses.gloss: f. (b. h.) Ḳ’siṭah, name of a standard value; a jewel, also a lamb (v. כְּסִיתָּא).
units: R. Hash. 26ᵃ כשהלכתי … קורין למעה ק׳ when I was on my way to Africa, (I heard them) call a m’ʿah ḳ’siṭah; לפרושי מאה ק׳ דאורייתא it serves to explain the Biblical ‘one hundred ḳ.’ (Gen. XXXIII, 19).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:7">Gen. R. s. 79</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="A00765"><he>אוּנְקְיָא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="H00479"><he>חוּרְפָא</he></cite>.
